ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: This course will investigate various methods of industrial and commercial production through hands-on experience. Students will gain in-depth technical proficiency in the areas of sign production, plotter-cut vinyl, CNC operation, and screen printing for both flat-stock and textiles. This section is restricted to Art+Design majors with sophomore standing or above.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
